fact: The Zimbabwe Republic Police ICT Directorate, headed by a Director ICT, is stated to be responsible for all ICT matters in the force, managing its ICT infrastructure and personnel through provincial ICT officers and systems administration, with a Professional Software Development Team under it; the page is dated 2024-03-14 and gives no other date.

The Government Internet Service Provider, a government body formed in 1998, is stated to provide internet connectivity, email and web services to all government ministries, departments and parastatals, and to administer the .gov.zw domain; the page carries no revision date, so 2026 is its published proxy year.
